title: Chuck Person’s Eccojams, Vol. 1
desc_lfm_artist:
An alias of Daniel Lopatin, better known as Oneohtrix Point Never. The first and only release was the 2010 cassette Chuck Person's Eccojams Vol. 1 on The Curatorial Club label. On Record Store Day 2012 four EPs were released on Software Records.

Some of the songs on the cassette contain the same songs which were posted on the youtube channel: sunsetcorp. There are also other songs that are in the same vein, albeit nameless.
